title: Document unit
summary: Generates or repairs managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration in the unit represented by a Structure-tree node (facts-only)
intro: Read this when a whole unit needs documentation, not just one symbol. Right-click the unit in the Structure form and choose Document unit to generate or repair managed DocInsight comments for its public declarations.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--apply|--json|--no-backup|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - generate/repair a managed DocInsight comment
